name: @shipcode/e2e
description: Repo-level end-to-end coverage for ShipCode (Playwright: Electron desktop, static web/docs, and CLI smoke).

scripts.e2e:ci: playwright test --reporter=list,html,json; pw=$?; node scripts/check-app-coverage.mjs; app=$?; node scripts/check-flow-coverage.mjs; flow=$?; node scripts/check-page-inventory.mjs; inventory=$?; node scripts/check-page-coverage.mjs; page=$?; node scripts/check-behavior-coverage.mjs; behavior=$?; if [ "$pw" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$pw"; fi; if [ "$app" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$app"; fi; if [ "$flow" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$flow"; fi; if [ "$inventory" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$inventory"; fi; if [ "$page" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$page"; fi; exit "$behavior"
